appraisal_events.evidence: Cette scène peina et alarma à un tel point la timidité de Saniette que... il feignit d'avoir mal au ventre... il enfila le couloir en feignant de chercher... les « water ».
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator shows Saniette fleeing in cowardly embarrassment from Cottard's high-handed treatment of the farmer, reaffirming his established image as the anxious, marginal figure among the fidèles.

appraisal_events.evidence: ses idées se ramenaient en réalité à deux ou trois, extrêmement courtes... une triomphante affectation de fausse précision, de faux bon sens... Elstir... eût pour lui la répulsion profonde.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator exposes M. Ski's showy cleverness as shallow affectation and notes that Elstir, whom Ski superficially resembles, feels a deep repulsion for him as an inferior copy of himself.

appraisal_events.evidence: la Patronne commençait à se dégoûter d'un fidèle par trop docile et de l'obéissance de qui elle était sûre d'avance.
appraisal_events.explanation: Even as Brichot grows more attached to the Verdurins, Mme Verdurin's regard for him quietly cools because his total, predictable obedience bores her.

status_effects.explanation: His panicked, furtive escape from an uncomfortable scene reaffirms his position as the anxious, marginal figure of the group.
The narrator's exposure of his superficial cleverness and Elstir's contempt for him diminish his standing despite his reputation within the clan.
His unwavering docility, once welcome, now leaves him vulnerable to the hostess's cooling favor, a quiet erosion of his position within the inner circle.
